# 1) Setup

## - Defining work directory

In this section, we define the working directory for the R Markdown document.

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
# Get the path of the current script
# Then get the parent directory of the parent directory of the parent directory
local_wd_folder <- dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))

# Set the root directory for knitr to the local working directory
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

## - Defining input data and output directories

Here, we define the directories for input data and output files.

```{r}
# Get the directory of the current script
script_folder <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)

# Define the data folder and output folder
data_folder <- './Data'
#results_folder <- './Results'
figures_folder <- './Figures'
```

## - Setting seed

Setting a seed ensures that any random processes are reproducible.

```{r}
# Set a seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)
```

## - Packages installation (optional)

In this section, we ensure that all necessary packages are installed.

```{r}
# Ensure BiocManager is available for installation of Bioconductor packages
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(version = "3.18", ask = TRUE)

# Define a list of required packages used in this script
packages_required <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "fgsea", "escape", "hrbrthemes", 
                       "tidyr", "ggpubr",
                       "unikn", "RColorBrewer", "yarrr", "scales", "ggsci")

# Identify any required packages that are not installed
packages_uninstalled <- packages_required[!(packages_required %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]

# Install any uninstalled packages
if(length(packages_uninstalled)) BiocManager::install(packages_uninstalled, ask = TRUE)
```

# 4) fGSEA Analyses

## - Create results directories

```{r}
Comparisons <- c('Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial',
                 'Comparisons_to_6hrs_control',
                 'Comparisons_to_24hrs_control',
                 'Comparisons_to_6hrs_LPS',
                 'Comparisons_to_24hrs_LPS')

for (comparison in Comparisons) {

  dir.create(
    file.path(paste0(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison)), showWarnings = F
  )
  
  dir.create(
    file.path(paste0(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/Hallmark')), showWarnings = F
  )
  
  dir.create(
    file.path(paste0(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/CanonicalPathways')), showWarnings = F
  )
  
  dir.create(
    file.path(paste0(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/GeneOntology')), showWarnings = F
  )
  
  dir.create(
    file.path(paste0(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/Other')), showWarnings = F
  )

}
```

### - Loading data

```{r}
DEGs_ALL <- list()

for (comparison in Comparisons) {
  
  message(paste0('Loading data for the following comparison: ', comparison))

  dirs <- list.files(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/', comparison, sep = ''))
  
  test_groups <- sub("Condition_(.*?)_vs_.*", "\\1", dirs)
  
  for (test in test_groups) {
    
    subdir <- dirs[str_detect(dirs, test)]
    DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]] <- read.csv(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/', comparison, '/', subdir, '/ALL_DEGs.csv', sep = ''))
    
  }
}
```

### - Gene ranking

Here we read in a CSV file containing differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between the blast phase and control. We then calculate a rank for each gene based on its log2 fold change and p-value. The DEGs are arranged by their rank. Finally, we prepare a named numeric vector of ranks, removing any NA values.

```{r}
Ranks <- list()

for (comparison in Comparisons) {
  
  dirs <- list.files(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/', comparison, sep = ''))
  
  test_groups <- sub("Condition_(.*?)_vs_.*", "\\1", dirs)
  
  for (test in test_groups) {
  
  message(paste0('Computing gene ranks for the following comparison: ', comparison, ' - test group: ', test))
    
  # Calculate rank
    DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]]$Rank <- sign(DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]]$log2FoldChange) * (-1 * log10(  DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]]$pvalue))
  
  # Arrange by rank
    DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]] <- DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]] %>% arrange(-Rank)
  
  # Prepare ranks
    Ranks[[comparison]][[test]] <-   DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]]$Rank
    names(Ranks[[comparison]][[test]]) <- DEGs_ALL[[comparison]][[test]]$Gene
    Ranks[[comparison]][[test]] <-   Ranks[[comparison]][[test]][!is.na(Ranks[[comparison]][[test]])]
                 
  }
}
```

### - Hallmark analysis

Here we read in a GMT file containing Hallmark pathways. We then perform a fast gene set enrichment analysis (fgsea) using the Hallmark pathways and the ranks of the DEGs. The results are arranged by the adjusted p-value.

We then write the full results to a CSV file. We also write two additional CSV files: one containing the pathways that are upregulated in the blast phase (BP-CMML) and one containing the pathways that are upregulated in the control.

```{r}
for (comparison in Comparisons) {
  
  dirs <- list.files(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/', comparison, sep = ''))
  
  test_groups <- sub("Condition_(.*?)_vs_.*", "\\1", dirs)
  
  for (test in test_groups) {
    
    # Read Hallmark pathways
    Hallmark_pathways_gmt_file <- paste(data_folder, '/Resources/RNASeq/Gene_Pathways/2022__GSEA_MSIGDB__h.all.v2022.1.Hs.symbols.gmt.txt', sep = '')
    Hallmark_pathways <- gmtPathways(Hallmark_pathways_gmt_file)
    str(head(Hallmark_pathways))
    
    # Perform fgsea
    fgseaRes_Hallmark <- fgsea(
      pathways = Hallmark_pathways, 
      stats = Ranks[[comparison]][[test]],
      minSize=10, 
      maxSize = 500, 
      nPermSimple = 10000
    )
    
    # Arrange by padj
    fgseaRes_Hallmark <- fgseaRes_Hallmark %>% arrange(padj)
    fgseaRes_Hallmark$leadingEdge <- NULL
    
    # Write results to csv
    write.csv(
      x = fgseaRes_Hallmark, 
      file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/Hallmark/fGSEA_', test, '_vs_0hrs_initial_all.csv', sep = '')
    )
    
    # Write upregulated in BP-CMML to csv
    write.csv(
      x = fgseaRes_Hallmark %>% filter(NES > 0), 
      file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/Hallmark/fGSEA_', test, '_vs_0hrs_Up_in_', test, '.csv', sep = '')
    )
    
    # Write upregulated in Control to csv
    write.csv(
      x = fgseaRes_Hallmark %>% filter(NES < 0), 
      file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/Hallmark/fGSEA_', test, '_vs_0hrs_Dn_in_', test, '.csv', sep = '')
    )
    
  }
}
```

### - Canonical pathway analysis

Here we read in a GMT file containing Canonical pathways. We then perform a fast gene set enrichment analysis (fgsea) using the Canonical pathways and the ranks of the DEGs. The results are arranged by the adjusted p-value.

We then write the full results to a CSV file. We also write two additional CSV files: one containing the pathways that are upregulated in the blast phase (BP-CMML) and one containing the pathways that are upregulated in the control.

```{r}
for (comparison in Comparisons) {
  
  dirs <- list.files(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/', comparison, sep = ''))
  
  test_groups <- sub("Condition_(.*?)_vs_.*", "\\1", dirs)
  
  for (test in test_groups) {
  
    # Read Canonical pathways
    CanonicalPathways_gmt_file <- paste(data_folder, '/Resources/RNASeq/Gene_Pathways/2022__GSEA_MSIGDB__c2.cp.v2022.1.Hs.symbols.gmt.txt', sep = '')
    CanonicalPathways <- gmtPathways(CanonicalPathways_gmt_file)
    str(head(CanonicalPathways))
    
    # Perform fgsea
    fgseaRes_CP <- fgsea(
      pathways = CanonicalPathways, 
      stats =  Ranks[[comparison]][[test]],
      minSize=10, 
      maxSize = 500, 
      nPermSimple = 10000
    )
    
    # Arrange by padj
    fgseaRes_CP <- fgseaRes_CP %>% arrange(padj)
    fgseaRes_CP$leadingEdge <- NULL
  
    # Write results to csv
    write.csv(
      x = fgseaRes_CP, 
      file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/CanonicalPathways/fGSEA_', test, '_vs_0hrs_initial_all.csv', sep = '')
    )
    
    # Write upregulated in BP-CMML to csv
    write.csv(
      x = fgseaRes_CP %>% filter(NES > 0), 
      file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/CanonicalPathways/fGSEA_', test, '_vs_0hrs_Up_in_', test, '.csv', sep = '')
    )
    
    # Write upregulated in Control to csv
    write.csv(
      x = fgseaRes_CP %>% filter(NES < 0), 
      file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Pathway_Analysis/Monocytes/Pathway_Comparisons/', comparison, '/CanonicalPathways/fGSEA_', test, '_vs_0hrs_Dn_in_', test, '.csv', sep = '')
    )
    
  }
}
```
